package mapper_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/kuangshp/gorm-plus/decimaljson"
	"github.com/kuangshp/gorm-plus/validation"
	"github.com/zeromicro/go-zero/rest/httpx"
	"gorm.io/driver/sqlite"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
	apiproto "jsonfixture/internal/apiproto"
	"jsonfixture/internal/mapper"
	"jsonfixture/internal/pb"
	"jsonfixture/internal/types"
	"jsonfixture/model"
)

func TestJSONGoZeroRoundTrip(t *testing.T) { // 经真实 HTTP 解析器、数据库、响应和 RPC 边界验证对象、数组及精度。
	db, err := gorm.Open(sqlite.Open(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "json.db")))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	pool, _ := db.DB()
	t.Cleanup(func() { pool.Close() })
	if err := db.AutoMigrate(&model.SamplesEntity{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	m, rpc := mapper.NewSamplesMapper(), apiproto.NewSamplesMapper()
	for _, raw := range []string{`{"id":9007199254740993,"nested":{"amount":12.34567890123456789},"list":[true,null,"红色"]}`, `[1,2,{"x":true}]`, `{}`, `[]`, `null`} {
		t.Run(raw, func(t *testing.T) {
			body := `{"name":"test","attributes":` + raw + `,"metadata":{"ok":true}}`
			r := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/", strings.NewReader(body))
			r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			var req types.CreateSamplesReq
			if err := decimaljson.PrepareRequest(r, &req); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := httpx.Parse(r, &req); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := validation.Validate(&req); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			entity, err := m.DtoToEntity(&req)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := db.Create(entity).Error; err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var loaded model.SamplesEntity
			if err := db.First(&loaded, entity.ID).Error; err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			response, err := json.Marshal(m.EntityToVO(&loaded))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			check := func(response []byte) {
				t.Helper()
				var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
				if err := json.Unmarshal(response, &fields); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				var want, got any
				decode := func(data []byte, dest *any) {
					dec := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(data)))
					dec.UseNumber()
					if err := dec.Decode(dest); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
				}
				decode([]byte(raw), &want)
				decode(fields["attributes"], &got)
				wantBytes, _ := json.Marshal(want)
				gotBytes, _ := json.Marshal(got)
				if string(wantBytes) != string(gotBytes) {
					t.Fatalf("JSON quoted or precision lost: want %s got %s", wantBytes, response)
				}
			}
			check(response)
			message, err := rpc.CreateReqToProto(&req)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			response, err = json.Marshal(rpc.ProtoToVO(&pb.SamplesModel{Attributes: *message.Attributes, Metadata: *message.Metadata}))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			check(response)
			if _, err := rpc.ModifyReqToProto(&types.ModifySamplesReq{CreateSamplesReq: req}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if _, err := rpc.PageReqToProto(&types.PageSamplesReq{Attributes: req.Attributes}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		})
	}
	if _, err := json.Marshal(rpc.ProtoToVO(&pb.SamplesModel{})); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("empty RPC field: %v", err)
	}
	bad := &types.CreateSamplesReq{Name: "bad", Attributes: make(chan int)}
	if _, err := m.DtoToEntity(bad); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("ignored JSON encoding error")
	}
	if _, err := rpc.CreateReqToProto(bad); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("ignored RPC JSON encoding error")
	}
}
